articles.title: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny
Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths

events.summary: Health officials are investigating whether Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria crossed paths at Uganda's primary airport. Uganda reported no active cases, but conflicting accounts surround the infection sources.
events.why: Potential cross-border airport transmission of Ebola presents severe epidemiological risks across multiple African nations.

articles.title: Doctors tell the BBC about the targeting of Sudanese hospitals by paramilitary fighters

events.summary: A BBC investigation revealed that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed the healthcare system in el-Fasher, according to local doctors.
events.why: The deliberate destruction of medical infrastructure leaves entire civilian populations without lifesaving care, compounding a humanitarian catastrophe.

articles.title: Are California voters about to impose world's first 'tax on billionaires'?

events.summary: California voters are set to decide on a ballot measure to levy a billionaire tax intended to fund healthcare improvements.
events.why: If enacted, it would establish a novel wealth-tax precedent with substantial fiscal consequences for healthcare and high-net-worth residents.

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted

events.summary: Ukraine reports that Starlink access remains restricted despite Donald Trump's claim that limits were lifted. The satellite network is critical to the Ukrainian military.
events.why: Starlink's operational status directly affects Ukrainian frontline command-and-control capabilities.

articles.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead

events.summary: Israeli forces initiated the demolition of Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers were killed at a checkpoint by Palestinian gunmen. The fatal shooting occurred on Friday morning outside the West Bank city.
events.why: Punitive home demolitions and deadly clashes escalate regional unrest and violate human rights standards.

articles.title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes a national security threat
Pentagon designates China-backed campus cultural centers a threat to US national security

events.summary: The Pentagon has designated Chinese-backed Confucius Institutes as a national security threat. Pete Hegseth stated the department dismantled 80 operating entities across 30 universities.
events.why: It formalizes defense policy against Chinese state-sponsored educational initiatives, impacting university partnerships and academic funding.

articles.title: 'It's part of the culture' - New York bans horse-drawn carriages after more than 160 years

events.summary: New York City has banned horse-drawn carriages, ending an industry that operated for over 160 years.
events.why: It enacts a permanent municipal prohibition ending a long-standing local tourism and transport industry.

articles.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say

events.summary: Former Ukrainian prisoners reported that a freed US citizen endured beatings and sexual humiliation from Russian guards during detention in a Russian jail.
events.why: Eyewitness evidence of torture against a US citizen compounds war crime allegations against Russian authorities.

articles.title: Watch: CCTV footage shows gunmen near church in Jordan

events.summary: Gunmen were captured on CCTV near a church in Jordan as a shooting occurred while dozens attended a funeral inside.
events.why: An armed attack targeting a church during a service threatens community safety and raises sectarian security concerns.

articles.title: Ruins of Limoges city hall a symbol of France divided by national protests

events.summary: The city hall of Limoges, France, was burned down amid national protests, sparking division among residents over the destruction.
events.why: The arson of a municipal seat of government highlights the escalating physical toll of nationwide civil unrest.
